card.name: Recipe steps and phone number digits
card.fires_on: Cooking verbs in recipe instructions (heat, cook, cover) and the digits or hyphens inside phone numbers. Also a colon after a dictionary headword.

modes.label: Recipe verbs
modes.description: Action verbs that begin or continue a cooking instruction, such as heat, cover, or cook.
modes.example: (Do not season.)<< Heat>> 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in Dutch oven

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: A digit or hyphen partway through a US phone number.

modes.description: The colon after Etymology in a dictionary entry.
